Name: QSMP Valley - 1.6 Edition
Author: mrhacwer
Description:

[b][b]ᯓ★[/b][color=#ff0000] [/color][/b][color=#ff0000]O diálogo nesse mod só funciona em inglês e português.[/color][/b][/quote][size=3]
[b][size=3]This mod requires [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url] to work properly.
[/b][b]You can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change some mod settings.[/b]

[font=Arial]It modifies the in-game [b]characters[/b] by replacing their [b]original sprites and portraits[/b] with those of the [b][color=#6d9eeb]QSMP[/color] participants[/b].
The goal of this mod is to add some fun and give a fresh look to the characters.

*Note:The original author [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Ebacereja/about-me?gameId=1303]Ebacereja[/url] who posted the first version of the mod gave me all permissions to me because I made the first version with him.
Keep in mind that this mod was kind of abandoned, so he asked me to update it to version 1.6 because some people wanted to play with this mod.
Therefore, this could be the last update. I’ll still fix any bugs or issues for a while.
